title: Shopping starts with AI while PC costs rise; our store must adapt to both
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). HP launched an agentic web platform; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. Gartner: Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4%.

points.headline: Competitors and platforms are rebuilding shopping around AI agents
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI, an agentic web platform; TikTok added a conversational shopping agent with one-click checkout; Gap added natural-language discovery. We should benchmark our discovery and checkout against these.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery channel, but agents can be blocked
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI during product discovery. TechCrunch reports anti-bot defenses block personal shopping agents. We should check that our store is readable by legitimate agents.

points.headline: PC volumes fall while costs and prices rise
points.detail: Gartner says Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% as component costs lifted ASPs; memory supply is shifting to server DRAM. We should plan pricing and promotions for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Electronics demand spikes at marketplace events
points.detail: Prime Big Deal Days drove $9.86B in US online sales, up 8.5%, with electronics up 85% versus the September daily average. We should line up PC promotions and inventory early.
